chapter: Back in New York: Heard and Dizzy
title: First uniforms: Hartley Toots's band in Cincinnati, 1939
summary: He first wore band uniforms in Cincinnati at the Cotton Club with Thad and Hank Jones, earning nine dollars a week.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Yeah, you'd mentioned it before and it had stuck in my mind as well. This thing with uniforms, I've been goin' to ask you a couple times; it may seem a silly question, but way back when you were first starting out with the high school band, did you have uniforms then?
When was the first time you...what was the first band that you were with that you really had uniforms?

Well in 1939, durin' the summer vacation from school we went to Cincinnati with Hartley Toots' Band and we met 'em there, Thad Jones and Hank Jones, we were out of...it was the guys from Pontiac and Lansing. There was two from Lansing and...three of us from Lansing, and

the rest of the guys were from Pontiac. And we were in Cincinat i at the Cotton Club and it was my first experience away from home. The uniform... we was makin' nine dollars a week, the uniform was five and the rent was four. So you know what... hahahaha. That's my first experience with uniforms. Hahahaha. I'll never forget that one.
It brings to mind something else I was going to ask you. You must have had to have a tailor-made uniform, with your size?
I was skinny, yeah I was skinny then.
